audit.scope: 15 built-in Codex full-image-generated BtoB SaaS banners
method: 1600x900 final PNG visual inspection at original resolution
comparison with each service JSON specification
comparison with public/<service>/hero.webp official UI reference
comparison with public/<service>/logo.png official logo reference
copy, line-break, feature-chip and CTA verification
brand mascot pose, dominance and cropping review
audit.decision_rule: Any incorrect or missing required copy, misleading or unconfirmed UI, major logo divergence, mascot-dominated composition, or damaging crop is REGENERATE. Minor spacing or intentional edge bleed without meaning loss is ACCEPT_WITH_NOTES.

items.official_ui_match: PASS: answer-assist panel content follows the official hero reference

issues.detail: The headset mascot occupies most of the right third and is visually stronger than the product UI, violating the requirement that the SaaS screen be the hero.
The UI panel is pushed behind the mascot and loses usable reading area.

regeneration_requirements: Rebuild the full image with the official UI occupying at least 55 percent of the canvas
Reduce mascot to no more than about 22 percent of canvas height
Keep the headset and cue-card pose but move it outside the UI reading area
Preserve every exact Japanese phrase and the pink CTA

items.official_ui_match: FAIL: the ranking panel matches the official reference, but an additional four-AI comparison panel is not present in the supplied official hero image

issues.detail: A second comparison panel with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity is visually presented as product UI without an official screenshot reference.
The mascot is cut off at the lower canvas edge, reducing finish quality.

regeneration_requirements: Use only the official AI visibility ranking UI as product UI
Do not add an unreferenced second dashboard or vendor-logo row
Keep the full mascot visible and secondary
Retain the mandatory CTA 無料で診断する

items.official_ui_match: FAIL: the main persona card follows the official reference, but added profile cards with star ratings are not present in the official hero image

issues.detail: Added star-rated profile cards resemble recruiting or candidate scoring and can misrepresent a marketing-persona product.
The invented card cluster competes with the real persona sheet and weakens the single-page persona benefit.

regeneration_requirements: Show only one official-style persona sheet as the product hero
Remove all star ratings, candidate cards and recruiting visual language
Keep the sticky-note analysis pose but reduce mascot scale
Preserve every exact Japanese phrase and CTA
